create_retrieval_constraint: create a RetrievalConstraint with a field name, constraint type, and value to filter documents
build_retrieval_constraints: build a RetrievalConstraints collection combining multiple RetrievalConstraint objects with AND logic
get_indices_for_constraint: get the set of document IDs matching a single RetrievalConstraint against a value-to-ID map
get_candidate_indices: get sorted candidate document IDs satisfying all constraints using field-to-value-to-ID mapping
define_constrained_retriever: define a ConstrainedRetriever protocol implementing retrieve and retrieve_with_scores with constraint filtering
